005package org.wpilib.math.optimization.ocp;
006
007/** Enum describing a type of system dynamics constraints. */
008public enum DynamicsType {
009  /** The dynamics are a function in the form dx/dt = f(t, x, u). */
010  EXPLICIT_ODE(0),
011  /** The dynamics are a function in the form xₖ₊₁ = f(t, xₖ, uₖ). */
012  DISCRETE(1);
013
014  /** DynamicsType value. */
015  public final int value;
016
017  DynamicsType(int value) {
018    this.value = value;
019  }
020}
